answer: The nebula panel is drawn blind, the delta escrow settles at close, and beacon lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 8% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 352 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
